stories.headline: RAPSODY REJECTS THE LABEL
stories.deck: Rapsody rejects the Christian-rapper label. Her new album makes room for faith, politics and real life.
stories.claim: Rapsody rejected the Christian-rapper label in a new interview while describing the faith, politics and Black cultural memory inside God Gotta Afro & Gold Hoops.

stories.headline: MADLIB CASE STAYS ALIVE
stories.deck: A judge kept Egon’s catalog case alive after denying Madlib’s dismissal bid. Ownership is still undecided.
stories.claim: U.S. Magistrate Judge John D. Early denied Madlib’s motion to dismiss Egon Alapatt’s amended catalog case; the court did not decide ownership and ordered Madlib to answer within 14 days.

stories.headline: YOUNG MIKO SELLS OUT LA
stories.deck: Young Miko sold out her first Intuit Dome show. The milestone caps her move from opener to arena headliner.
stories.claim: Young Miko sold out her October 17 Intuit Dome stop during the Late Checkout Tour, with Destin Conrad joining her for “no debo :(”.

stories.headline: ONEFOUR MEETS STRINGS
stories.deck: ONEFOUR’s Sydney commission pairs Western drill with Penrith strings. Jan. 22–23.
stories.claim: ONEFOUR will join the Penrith Chamber Orchestra for a new commission at the Joan Sutherland Performing Arts Centre during Sydney Festival 2027 on January 22–23.

stories.headline: GTA VI MAY FIX THE STUTTER
stories.deck: GTA VI’s launch trailer shows no obvious animation stutter. Digital Foundry calls the fix possible—not confirmed.
stories.claim: Digital Foundry’s read of the October 15 GTA VI launch trailer found no obvious animation stutter, suggesting but not confirming a fix for a long-running RAGE-engine issue.
